summary: Refuse incomplete tool argument documents without losing complete JSON repair at the parser boundary.

patterns: parseToolArguments returns an object input and an optional parseError without throwing.
Strict JSON parsing and control-character or invalid-escape repair accept complete documents.
The parser accepts complete JSON inside a fence or prose envelope.
constraints: Preserve parseToolArguments, ParsedToolArguments, and the existing parseJsonWithRepair helper contract.
Do not return values manufactured by completing an incomplete document.
Keep empty, whitespace-only, and absent argument buffers as a successful empty object.
Do not change tests, dependency setup, or runtime composition. This task covers only the parser module, not adapter or dispatch behavior.

milestones.goal: Accept complete objects and existing complete repairs while returning an empty input and parseError for incomplete, unparseable, or non-object payloads.

tasks.description: Revise the final argument parsing path so tolerant prefix completion cannot become tool input. Preserve complete strict JSON, escaped characters, raw control-character and invalid-escape repair, complete fences and prose envelopes, and the existing empty-buffer contract. Reject truncated strings, cuts between fields, partial enveloped JSON, unparseable text, and non-object roots without throwing.
test_scenarios: A buffer cut inside a string or between fields returns input {} and a nonempty parseError.
Partial JSON inside a fence or prose envelope returns input {} and a nonempty parseError.
Complete JSON retains every field and value, including nested values and escaped characters.
Complete raw control characters and invalid escapes are repaired without completing truncated documents.
Complete fenced and prose-enveloped objects remain accepted.
Unparseable text and non-object JSON roots return input {} and a nonempty parseError.
Absent, empty, and whitespace-only buffers remain successful empty inputs.

milestones.verification: bun -e 'import { parseToolArguments } from "./src/orchestration/agent-runtime/llm/json-parse.ts"; const result = parseToolArguments("{\"content\":\"cut"); if (!result.parseError || Object.keys(result.input).length) throw new Error("incomplete arguments accepted"); const complete = parseToolArguments("{\"content\":\"line1\nline2\"}"); if (complete.parseError || complete.input.content !== "line1\nline2") throw new Error("complete repair failed");'
milestones.qualitative_verification: No tolerant prefix completion becomes a successful argument object.

success_criteria: Incomplete buffers never return a shortened argument object.
All complete supported forms retain their values.
Rejected buffers return input {} with a nonempty parseError and never throw.
Empty supported buffers remain successful empty inputs.
No adapter, dispatcher, or full agent-loop claim is made by this module repair.
